problem.cause: _capture_failure_diagnostics writes logs only for services that are not running or not healthy. A healthy owner answering 4xx/5xx, or a worker logging a handled error, leaves no trace.

change: On a failed run the harness now also scans the last 1000 log lines of every compose service listed by ps. It keeps only error-signal lines (ERROR, CRITICAL, Traceback, Exception, or an HTTP access log line with a 4xx/5xx status), at most the last 40 per service, in diagnostics/service-error-lines.txt. A section header per service records the total count, so zero is explicit.
Unhealthy and exited services still get their full 200-line logs-<service>.txt exactly as before, and healthy services still get no full log file.
test_changes: test_failure_diagnostics_capture_ps_and_unhealthy_logs now separates the 200-line full-log calls (still only projector and sick) from the 1000-line scan calls (all three services) and checks the zero-count sections.
